Fajita Pita
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 1:20am

Ingredients




18 pounds BEEF,OVEN ROAST FZ
cup GARLIC DEHY GRA
pound TOMATOES FRESH
1 cup LEMON FRESH
5 pounds ONIONS DRY
8 ounces ONIONS DRY
5 pounds PEPPER SWT GRN FRESH
2 tablespoons SUGAR, GRANULATED 10 LB
1 cup SHORTENING, 3LB
1 cup SHORTENING, 3LB
2 tablespoons PEPPER BLACK 1 LB CN
2 teaspoons PEPPER RED GROUND
13 ounces PEPPER PICKLE JALAP
3 tablespoons SALT TABLE 5LB
tablespoon SALT TABLE 5LB

Preparation

1 PREPARE 1 RECIPE SALSA (RECIPE NO. O-25-2). REFRIGERATE FOR USE IN STEP 2  3 CUT BEEF INTO 1/4" THIN SLICES; CUT SLICES INTO 1/4" STRIPS, 2-3" LONG. 4 POUR LEMON JUICE OVER BEEF. 5 COMBINE SALT, GARLIC, ONION POWDER, BLACK PEPPER, CUMIN, AND RED PEPER; SPRINKLE OVER BEEF; MIX THOROUGHLY; COVER; MARINATE IN REFRIGERTOR 1 HOUR. 6 SAUTE ONIONS AND PEPPERS IN MELTED SHORTENING OR SALAD OIL IN STEAM- JACKETED KETTLE OR STOCK POT ABOUT 10 MINUTES OR UNTIL ALMOST TRANSPARENT. KEEP HOT FOR USE IN STEP 7. 7 BROWN BEEF STRIPS, TURNING FREQUENTLY, 1-2 MINUTES ON LIGHTLY GREASED GRIDDLE. 8 CUT FROZEN THAWED PITA BREAD IN HALF. PLACE 2 1/4 OZ (1/3 CUP) 9 BEEF STRIPS AND 3 TBSP ONIONS AND GREEN PEPPERS IN EACH PITA HALF. 10 SERVE WITH SALSA. 11 NOTE: 12 IN STEP 1, 1 RECIPE TACO SAUCE, RECIPE NO. O-25 MAY BE USED FOR SALSA, RECIPE NO. O-25- 13  14 IN STEP 5, 5 LB 9 OZ DRY ONIONS A.P. WILL YIELD 5 LB ONION STRIPS, 6 LB 1 OZ SWEET PEPPERS A.P. WILL YIELD 5 LB SWEET PEPPER STRIPS. 15 IN STEP 2, 1 LB 8 OZ FRESH LEMONS (6 LEMONS) A.P. WILL YIELD 1 CUP LEMON JUICE. 16 IN STEP 8, FAJITAS MAY BE SERVED WITH A TOOTHPICK. 17 IN STEP 7, BROWN BEEF STRIPS IN BATCHES OF NO MORE THAN 25 PORTIONS. 18 IN STEP 9, SALSA MAY BE PLACED ON THE SERVING LINE FOR SELF SERVICE. 19 IN STEP 9, FAJITAS MAY BE SERVED WITH GUACAMOLE. PREPARE 1 RECIPE GUACAMOLE, RECIPE NO. M-25. EACH PORTION: 2 TBSP (1 OZ). 20 SERVING SIZE: 1/2 PITA (
